_note: The volume rail is drawn only for a television that is ON, and a set is off most of the day. This patch turns one on and gives its player a real volume_level, so the ladder, the numeral and the cap can be photographed without touching anybody's television. Copy to tvvol.json and fill in your own ids; `sheets` must carry the WHOLE deployed sheets block, because plain keys assign over the top rather than merging.
